incidents.title: AWS S3 SDK Usage in Web Module
incidents.description: Application uses AWS S3 SDK (software.amazon.awssdk:s3:2.25.13) for cloud storage. This needs to be migrated to Azure Blob Storage.
incidents.recommendation: Replace AWS S3 SDK with Azure Blob Storage SDK (com.azure:azure-storage-blob). Update service implementations to use BlobServiceClient and BlobContainerClient.

incidents.title: AWS S3 SDK Usage in Worker Module
incidents.description: Worker module uses AWS S3 SDK for thumbnail processing and file operations.
incidents.recommendation: Migrate to Azure Blob Storage SDK. Update file processing service to use Azure Blob operations.

incidents.title: S3 Client Configuration
incidents.description: S3Client configuration uses AWS credentials and regions that need to be adapted for Azure.
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure DefaultAzureCredential for managed identity support. Configure Azure storage account connection strings.

incidents.title: Hardcoded AWS Credentials in Web Module
incidents.description: AWS access keys are hardcoded in application.properties which is a security risk.
incidents.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials. Use Azure Managed Identity (DefaultAzureCredential) or Azure Key Vault for credential management.

incidents.title: Hardcoded AWS Credentials in Worker Module
incidents.description: AWS access keys are hardcoded in worker application.properties.
incidents.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials. Use Azure Managed Identity (DefaultAzureCredential) or Azure Key Vault.

incidents.title: RabbitMQ Dependency in Web Module
incidents.description: Application uses RabbitMQ (spring-boot-starter-amqp) for messaging. Should be migrated to Azure Service Bus.
incidents.recommendation: Replace spring-boot-starter-amqp with spring-cloud-azure-starter-servicebus. Update messaging configuration and templates.

incidents.title: RabbitMQ Dependency in Worker Module
incidents.description: Worker module uses RabbitMQ for receiving image processing messages.
incidents.recommendation: Migrate to Azure Service Bus with spring-cloud-azure-starter-servicebus.

incidents.title: RabbitMQ Configuration
incidents.description: RabbitMQ configuration with hardcoded credentials needs migration.
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Service Bus connection strings or managed identity configuration.

incidents.title: PostgreSQL Configuration
incidents.description: Application uses PostgreSQL database which can be migrated to Azure Database for PostgreSQL.
incidents.recommendation: Update connection strings for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Consider using Azure Managed Identity for database authentication.

incidents.title: Hardcoded Database Credentials
incidents.description: Database username and password are hardcoded in configuration files.
incidents.recommendation: Use Azure Key Vault to store sensitive credentials or use Azure Managed Identity for database connections.

incidents.title: Spring Boot Version
incidents.description: Application uses Spring Boot 3.2.1. Consider upgrading to latest LTS version for better Azure integration.
incidents.recommendation: Upgrade to Spring Boot 3.3.x or later for improved Azure SDK compatibility and features.

incidents.title: S3 List Objects API
incidents.description: Uses S3 ListObjectsV2 API that needs Azure equivalent.
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure BlobContainerClient.listBlobs() method.

incidents.title: S3 Put Object API
incidents.description: Uses S3 PutObject API for file uploads.
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure BlobClient.upload() method.

incidents.title: S3 Get Object API
incidents.description: Uses S3 GetObject API for file downloads.
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure BlobClient.downloadContent() method.

incidents.title: S3 Delete Object API
incidents.description: Uses S3 DeleteObject API.
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure BlobClient.delete() method.

incidents.title: S3 Head Object API
incidents.description: Uses S3 HeadObject API to check object existence.
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure BlobClient.exists() method.

incidents.title: S3 File Processing in Worker
incidents.description: Worker module performs S3 operations for thumbnail generation.
incidents.recommendation: Update to use Azure Blob Storage operations.

incidents.title: RabbitTemplate Usage
incidents.description: Uses RabbitTemplate for sending messages.
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure ServiceBusSenderClient.

incidents.title: RabbitListener Usage
incidents.description: Uses @RabbitListener annotation for message consumption.
incidents.recommendation: Replace with @ServiceBusListener annotation.

incidents.title: Queue Declaration
incidents.description: Queue is declared programmatically in RabbitConfig.
incidents.recommendation: Azure Service Bus queues should be created via Azure Portal or Infrastructure as Code.

incidents.title: Profile-based Configuration
incidents.description: Application uses Spring profiles for dev vs. cloud environments.
incidents.recommendation: Profile strategy is good. Add 'azure' profile for Azure-specific configuration.

incidents.title: S3-specific Model Classes
incidents.description: Model classes reference S3-specific terminology.
incidents.recommendation: Rename to cloud-agnostic names like 'StorageItem' or 'BlobStorageItem'.

incidents.title: S3-specific Controller Names
incidents.description: Controller is named S3Controller.
incidents.recommendation: Rename to cloud-agnostic name like 'StorageController'.

incidents.title: Missing Application Insights
incidents.description: No Azure Application Insights integration for monitoring and diagnostics.
incidents.recommendation: Add Azure Application Insights SDK for comprehensive monitoring.

incidents.title: AWS SDK Dependency Version
incidents.description: AWS SDK version is explicitly managed in properties.
incidents.recommendation: Remove AWS SDK dependency management when migrating to Azure SDKs.

incidents.title: Multipart File Size Configuration
incidents.description: File upload size limits configured for Tomcat.
incidents.recommendation: Configuration is compatible with Azure. No changes needed.

incidents.title: Message Serialization
incidents.description: Message serialization needs to be verified for Azure Service Bus compatibility.
incidents.recommendation: Ensure JSON serialization is compatible with Service Bus message format.

incidents.title: Backup Message Processor
incidents.description: Application has backup message processor for RabbitMQ.
incidents.recommendation: Update to work with Azure Service Bus dead letter queue.

incidents.title: Image Metadata Repository
incidents.description: JPA repository for image metadata storage.
incidents.recommendation: Compatible with Azure Database for PostgreSQL. No changes needed.

incidents.title: Lombok Usage
incidents.description: Application uses Lombok for boilerplate code reduction.
incidents.recommendation: Compatible with Azure. No changes needed.

incidents.title: Jackson JSON Library
incidents.description: Uses Jackson for JSON serialization.
incidents.recommendation: Compatible with Azure Service Bus. No changes needed.

incidents.title: S3-specific Exception Handling
incidents.description: Exception handling may be specific to AWS S3 exceptions.
incidents.recommendation: Update exception handling to catch Azure Storage exceptions (BlobStorageException).

incidents.title: RabbitMQ Exception Handling
incidents.description: Exception handling specific to RabbitMQ operations.
incidents.recommendation: Update to handle Azure Service Bus exceptions (ServiceBusException).

incidents.title: Test Configuration Updates
incidents.description: Test configurations need to be updated for Azure services.
incidents.recommendation: Update test configurations to use Azure emulators or mocks for Blob Storage and Service Bus.

recommendations.title: Migrate AWS S3 to Azure Blob Storage
recommendations.description: Replace AWS S3 SDK with Azure Blob Storage SDK across both web and worker modules.
tasks: Update Maven dependencies to use azure-storage-blob
Update configuration to use Azure storage account
Update model classes and controller names

recommendations.title: Migrate RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus
recommendations.description: Replace RabbitMQ with Azure Service Bus for message queuing.
tasks: Update Maven dependencies to use spring-cloud-azure-starter-servicebus

recommendations.title: Implement Azure Managed Identity
recommendations.description: Remove hardcoded credentials and implement Azure Managed Identity for secure authentication.
tasks: Configure Azure Key Vault for sensitive configuration
Update connection strings for Azure Database for PostgreSQL

recommendations.title: Migrate to Azure Database for PostgreSQL
recommendations.description: Update database configuration for Azure Database for PostgreSQL.

recommendations.title: Add Azure Application Insights
recommendations.description: Integrate Azure Application Insights for monitoring and diagnostics.
tasks: Configure instrumentation key or connection string

recommendations.title: Upgrade Spring Boot Version
recommendations.description: Upgrade to latest Spring Boot LTS version for better Azure compatibility.
tasks: Update Spring Boot version in parent POM

architecture.notes: Multi-module architecture is cloud-friendly. Good separation of concerns between web and worker modules. Uses Spring profiles for environment-specific configuration.

dependencies.notes: Heavy dependency on AWS services (S3, RabbitMQ implied through AMQP). All need migration to Azure equivalents.

security.notes: Major security concerns with hardcoded credentials in configuration files. No secrets management solution in place.

configuration.notes: Uses Spring Boot configuration management. Profile-based configuration is a good practice. Needs update for Azure services.

dataManagement.notes: Uses standard JPA/Hibernate with PostgreSQL. Highly compatible with Azure Database for PostgreSQL.

observability.notes: No monitoring or logging framework integrated. Needs Azure Application Insights.

factors.codeChanges: Medium - Requires refactoring of storage and messaging services across two modules
factors.testing: Medium - Need to update tests for Azure services
factors.dataMigration: Low - Database schema compatible with Azure PostgreSQL
factors.configurationChanges: High - Major configuration updates needed for all Azure services
factors.securityChanges: High - Need to implement managed identity and remove hardcoded credentials
